facts.business: Shree Securities Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) operating in India's financial services sector.
key_risks: Regulatory risk from RBI norms on capital adequacy, provisioning, governance, and scale-based regulation
Credit risk, liquidity risk, and interest rate volatility
Asset-liability mismatches and dependence on short-term borrowings
Geopolitical tensions and commodity price volatility
Compliance delays and penalties under SEBI LODR Regulations
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for advancing loans, giving guarantees, and providing securities to subsidiaries, associates, joint ventures, or entities in which directors are interested under Section 185 of the Companies Act, 2013, up to an aggregate limit of 60% of paid-up share capital, free reserves and securities premium account or 100% of free reserves and securities premium account, whichever is more.
